limitations: Metadata and supplied observations are declarations, not authenticated installation or conformance evidence.
Memory figures are per component; simultaneous runtime consumption is unmeasured.
This preview performs no installation and cannot authorize execution or spending.
The operator preview policy accepts unknown memory requirements; actual runtime memory remains unmeasured.

allowed_data_rights: Private local verification only; preserve bundled license notices. No redistribution reviewed.

effects: Create a new private Python environment and sibling installation journal/lock.
Install only reviewed local wheels; no index, source builds, host activation or sign-in.
Reserve staged/expanded wheel bytes and 500 MiB bootstrap headroom above the 50 GiB host reserve.
Keep failed/interrupted state; no automatic retry. Preserve the journal on removal.
Remove only a completely unchanged owned runtime; preserve conflicts for inspection.
